note: The speech engine the desktop app ships (DECISIONS.md D51, D53): NVIDIA's NeMo-Speech.cpp, built CPU-only for the work laptop's instruction sets, as Phase 33 benchmarked it. scripts/build-stt-runtime.ps1 builds it into src-tauri/stt-runtime/ (gitignored); pack-desktop.mjs stages those files beside describe.exe; make-notices.mjs lists them. The top-level fields are the processor engine; `vulkan` is the second engine (Phase 37), built into stt-runtime/vulkan/, which pack-desktop.mjs stages in vulkan\ beside describe.exe and make-notices.mjs also lists.
name: NeMo-Speech.cpp

vulkan.note: The second engine (DECISIONS.md D58, Phase 37): the same source, commit and MSVC runtime, built for Vulkan, in stt-runtime/vulkan/. Stock ggml, as NVIDIA builds Vulkan. vulkan-1.dll is the graphics driver's and is never shipped.
